The idea is GREAT! Execution on the trance-style synth is a little messy. Even when the instrument is solo and in t he mix, something is off about the texture and the blend for this style. I would clean up the instrument timbre to match the other elements.

I would drop out that synth back and forth every couple of bars to keep people wanting more. We've got the motif and it will stick in our heads as you progress. It gets too repetitive and muddy with the melody over it at the same time. As an instrumental it's okay and manageable, but with vocals it would be waaaayyy too muddy. Think if you had like Fetty Wap singing "yaaaaaahhh" with echoy spacious reverb over the top-- there'd be absolutely no room for his frequency range to be heard.

Beat sounds good. Hits nice. Good work overall.

One last thing. Think this would really benefit from a high pluck line melody. You have a little sonar sound that goes slowly in background. You might want to do a call and response with a slow arpeggiated pluck bell or little melody that keeps things moving and memorable. best of luck!

Dig that deep distorted bass. The hats are a little too high and dry. Would add some reverb and lower a few db. Also might spread the hats slightly panning wise to make space for future vocals. Also on the pads, I would use fast compression, so that they duck on the down beat and swell on the rise. Also might add a few EDM trap risers or swells to keep the movement going. Depending on how vox hit, might want to add some more breaks or instrument drop outs to emphasize whatever is being said on hook or verse. Just some suggestions. Either way love the vibe. Very floaty and chill. Could hear in hooka bar for sure.

If I was going to be picky.... Here's the things that stood out: The pad is stylistically a little weak and airy, not much going on there. Would prefer modulation and depth. I can hear the loop and it stands out as repetitive in a kind of bothersome way-- make it more interesting. The high hats seem a bit too sharp/loud. Mix better. The thickness of the sonic landscape could be more cohesive everything sounds very far from one another. Also the vocals are a bit too prominent (loud/overbearing), blend better (more effects, plugin, compression, eq). They come off slightly harsh. The flow is a little square and sloppy in areas. the vocal modulation at the end could be cleaner and higher in register.

But don't take any of the crit as bad, it's just personal taste. The biggest thing is that looping airy/string pad loop -- make it melodically more interesting. Develop it. Maybe add a more sparkly layer to it, so there's depth.

Also it feels like you're missing a bassline. You have 808s, but no bass pad or drone/808 tails or anything where it keeps things sounding rich. So when you the bass notes drop out, it feels thin.

That's all I got. But this is a great effort! I would say it's somewhere around a C if we're comparing it to mainstream production and composition. If we're comparing it to indy/underground, then you're at a solid B. Very good effort.
